title: Cyber Engineering- Network& Endpoint Engineer- Hyderabad
description:
The Cyber security team is a team within Information Technology Services servicing both internal and external facing business units for Deloitte USI.

  
  

**Work you'll do**

As a Network& Endpoint Engineer on the ITS Cybersecurity team, you will be responsible for:

* Work as a Network and Endpoint Engineer in the ITS Cybersecurity Team supporting Deloitte USI.
* Engineer and optimize Zscaler proxy and security controls, with a strong focus on secure web gateway policy, CASB, URL filtering, SSL/TLS inspection and inline DLP.
* Develop and maintain forward-proxy and web security policies, including URL categorization, PAC and proxy behavior, authentication flows, SSL/TLS inspection, bypasses, policy tuning, exception handling and troubleshooting.
* Troubleshoot end-to-end traffic flows across endpoints, proxies, DNS, firewalls, NAT, routing, VPN and Internet egress, using logs and packet-level evidence to isolate connectivity and security-policy issues. Support network security engineering using Palo Alto Networks technologies, including firewall policy, segmentation, routing, NAT, VPN, and secure connectivity.
* Investigate security events by correlating activity across proxy, firewall, DNS, network and endpoint telemetry, and support containment and remediation. Improve monitoring and detection coverage through log analysis, dashboards and alert tuning, with visibility across proxy, firewall, DNS, and network data sources.
* Partner with network, infrastructure, cloud, identity and application teams to assess technical risk and implement secure connectivity and security improvements. Automate repetitive Cyber Operations activities using scripting, APIs and orchestration, and maintain clear technical documentation, standards and runbooks. Coach and mentor junior team members to enhance their knowledge and skills. Stay up to date with the latest security technologies and trends. Build rapport with senior stakeholders to continually broaden and strengthen relationships. Present with presence and confidence to leadership and senior stakeholders. Drive and contribute to a positive and constructive culture. Share knowledge and implement opportunities for improvement from lessons learned activities.

**The team**

The Cybersecurity team at Deloitte USI, part of ITS group, is dedicated to protecting the company's digital assets and infrastructure. With a focus on maintaining a secure and resilient security posture, the team uses industry-standard security practices and tools to manage risks and respond to security incidents. Their goal is to ensure the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of Deloitte Australia's data, systems, and applications.

  
  

**Location: Hyderabad**

  
  

**Shift Timings: 06:30 AM to 03:30 PM**

  
  

**Qualifications**

Required:

* Minimum of 3 years of experience in Cloud Security & AI Security.
* Strong hands-on knowledge of Zscaler services and policy administration, particularly secure web gateway, CASB, URL filtering, SSL/TLS inspection and inline DLP - Must
* Experience designing, tuning and troubleshooting enterprise proxy services, including forward proxy architectures, PAC files, authentication, SSL/TLS inspection, certificate chains, proxy bypass requirements and Internet egress patterns. -Must
* Strong understanding of network traffic flows and protocols, including TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, TLS, NAT, routing, switching, VPNs and load balancing. - Must
* Hands-on experience with Palo Alto Networks security technologies, including firewall policy, routing, segmentation, NAT, VPN and traffic or packet analysis. -Must
* Practical experience investigating endpoint security events and correlating endpoint activity with proxy and network telemetry. Experience supporting cyber security incidents and correlating endpoints, proxy and network telemetry to identify root cause and coordinate remediation.
* Strong working knowledge of security monitoring and log analysis, including correlation, dashboarding, and development or tuning of searches and alerts - Must. Experience troubleshooting complex connectivity issues across endpoints, proxies, firewalls, cloud services and upstream network paths, with the ability to interpret proxy logs, firewall logs, DNS results, TLS failures and packet captures -Must. Strong communication skills and the ability to guide initiatives, coordinate delivery, and drive continuous improvement.

Preferred:

Certification Preferred (Nice to have):

Senior Hospital Billing Manager – Cash Billing, Insurance Billing & Insurance Empanelment

**Department:** Cash & Insurance Billing  
**Designation:** Senior Hospital Billing Manager  
**Location:** Hyderabad  
**Industry:** Healthcare / Hospital  
**Reporting To:** Hospital Operations Head / General Manager / Management  
**Experience:** 5–8 years in hospital billing, insurance billing, and empanelment, preferably with managerial experience.

1. Job Summary

The Senior Hospital Billing Manager is responsible for overseeing the complete hospital billing operations, including cash billing, insurance billing, corporate billing, TPA coordination, and insurance empanelment. The role involves ensuring accurate billing, timely claim submission, effective revenue management, denial reduction, and compliance with hospital policies and insurance guidelines.

The position requires strong knowledge of hospital billing software, insurance processes, cash collection, claim settlement, and coordination with clinical, finance, front office, and insurance departments.

2. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Cash Billing Management

* Supervise all cash billing activities for OPD, IPD, emergency, diagnostics, pharmacy, and other hospital services.
* Ensure accurate billing of consultations, procedures, investigations, surgeries, room charges, and other hospital services.
* Monitor daily cash collections, card payments, UPI transactions, and other payment modes.
* Ensure proper reconciliation of daily collections with billing reports and finance records.
* Monitor bill cancellations, refunds, discounts, concessions, and credit notes in accordance with hospital policies.
* Ensure all discounts and concessions are approved by authorized personnel.
* Monitor pending bills, outstanding payments, and unbilled services.
* Ensure proper preparation and submission of daily billing and collection reports to management.
* Identify billing discrepancies and implement corrective measures.
* Ensure compliance with hospital billing procedures and financial controls.

B. Insurance and TPA Billing Management

* Manage the complete insurance billing process for cashless and reimbursement cases.
* Coordinate with insurance companies, Third-Party Administrators (TPAs), and corporate clients.
* Ensure timely submission of pre-authorization requests for planned and emergency admissions.
* Verify patient insurance eligibility, policy validity, coverage, exclusions, and applicable limits.
* Coordinate with doctors, nursing staff, medical records, pharmacy, and other departments to obtain the necessary documentation.
* Ensure accurate preparation and submission of final bills, discharge summaries, investigation reports, prescriptions, and other supporting documents.
* Monitor claim submissions, query responses, approvals, deductions, and settlements.
* Follow up on pending claims, delayed payments, short settlements, and rejected claims.
* Analyse claim rejections and deductions and implement corrective actions to minimize revenue loss.
* Ensure compliance with insurance company and TPA billing guidelines, agreed package rates, and contractual terms.
* Maintain proper records of insurance claims, outstanding amounts, approvals, and settlements.
* Coordinate with the finance department for insurance receivables reconciliation.
* Ensure timely resolution of billing queries raised by insurance companies and TPAs.
* Monitor insurance-related discharge processes to minimize delays for patients.

C. Insurance Empanelment and Corporate Tie-Ups

* Identify and coordinate with insurance companies, TPAs, corporate organizations, and other healthcare payers for hospital empanelment.
* Handle the complete empanelment process, including application preparation, document submission, follow-ups, and agreement execution.
* Prepare and maintain hospital documents required for empanelment, including registrations, licences, certifications, infrastructure details, doctor profiles, and other supporting records.
* Coordinate with insurance companies and TPAs for hospital inspections, audits, and credential verification.
* Negotiate and coordinate with management regarding package rates, tariffs, payment terms, and contractual conditions.
* Review empanelment agreements, tariff structures, package rates, exclusions, and billing guidelines before implementation.
* Coordinate with management and the legal department for agreement review and renewal.
* Maintain an updated database of empanelled insurance companies, TPAs, corporate clients, and their respective agreements.
* Monitor agreement expiry dates and initiate renewal processes well in advance.
* Coordinate with insurance companies for tariff revisions and addition of new medical procedures and services.
* Develop and maintain professional relationships with insurance representatives, TPA officials, and corporate HR teams.
* Identify opportunities to increase insurance and corporate patient volumes.

D. Revenue Cycle Management and Outstanding Follow-Up

* Monitor the complete revenue cycle from patient registration and billing to claim submission and final payment.
* Review daily, weekly, and monthly billing and collection performance.
* Track insurance and corporate receivables and ensure timely follow-up.
* Prepare ageing reports for outstanding claims and unpaid invoices.
* Coordinate with the finance team to reconcile insurance receivables and payment records.
* Identify revenue leakages arising from missed charges, incorrect tariffs, unauthorized discounts, and documentation errors.
* Monitor claim settlement timelines and escalate long-pending cases to the concerned authorities.
* Develop strategies to reduce billing errors, claim rejections, and outstanding receivables.
* Ensure proper documentation and audit trails for all financial transactions.
* Support internal and external audits relating to billing, insurance claims, and collections.

E. Team Management and Coordination

* Supervise billing executives, cash billing staff, insurance coordinators, and empanelment personnel.
* Allocate duties and responsibilities to team members and monitor their performance.
* Train staff on hospital billing software, insurance procedures, tariff structures, and documentation requirements.
* Ensure adequate staffing and smooth functioning of billing operations across shifts.
* Conduct regular reviews of billing accuracy, claim processing, collections, and pending cases.
* Coordinate with the following departments:
* Front Office and Patient Registration
* Finance and Accounts
* Medical Records Department (MRD)
* Pharmacy
* Nursing Department
* Doctors and Consultants
* Operations and Administration
* Corporate and Marketing Departments
* Resolve patient billing complaints and insurance-related grievances professionally.
* Ensure adherence to hospital policies, confidentiality requirements, and departmental SOPs.

F. Hospital Billing Software and MIS Reporting

* Ensure effective use of hospital information systems (HIS/HMS) and billing software.
* Monitor correct tariff mapping, package configuration, billing entries, and insurance coding where applicable.
* Ensure accurate recording of cash, insurance, and corporate transactions.
* Generate and analyse daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports.
* Prepare reports covering:
* Daily cash collections.
* OPD and IPD billing.
* Insurance and corporate billing.
* Cashless pre-authorizations.
* Claims submitted and settled.
* Pending insurance claims.
* Claim rejections and deductions.
* Outstanding receivables and ageing.
* Discounts, refunds, and concessions.
* Empanelment status and agreement renewals.
* Present billing and revenue performance reports to management.
* Recommend improvements in billing processes, reporting accuracy, and revenue collection.

3. Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Business Administration, Hospital Administration, or a related field.
* MBA in Hospital Administration, Healthcare Management, or Finance is preferred.
* Additional training or certification in hospital revenue cycle management or medical billing is an advantage.

4. Required Experience

* 5–8 years of experience in hospital billing, insurance billing, and revenue cycle management.
* Previous experience handling a hospital billing team in a multispecialty hospital is preferred.
* Practical experience in cashless insurance processing, TPA coordination, corporate billing, and insurance empanelment is essential.
* Experience handling insurance claim rejections, deductions, outstanding receivables, and settlement follow-ups.
* Knowledge of hospital billing software and MIS reporting.

5. Required Skills

* Strong knowledge of hospital cash and insurance billing procedures.
* Knowledge of insurance companies, TPAs, and cashless authorization processes.
* Experience in insurance empanelment and corporate tie-ups.
* Strong financial reconciliation and analytical skills.
* Excellent negotiation and communication skills.
* Team leadership and staff management capabilities.
* Good knowledge of MS Excel, MIS reports, and hospital billing software.
* Ability to handle patient billing disputes and insurance escalations.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.

6. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Effective follow-up of pending claims and outstanding receivables.

This job description is structured around hospital billing responsibilities commonly required in Hyderabad hospitals, including IPD/OPD billing, insurance and TPA coordination, discharge billing, and revenue cycle management. raosentcare.com

1. Job Purpose

The Hospital Billing Sr. Executive is responsible for managing daily billing operations, ensuring accurate and timely preparation of patient bills, coordinating with insurance companies and Third-Party Administrators (TPAs), monitoring outstanding payments, and facilitating smooth patient admission and discharge processes.

The position ensures billing accuracy, proper documentation, compliance with hospital policies, and improved revenue collection.

2. Key Responsibilities

**A. Hospital Billing Operations**

* Supervise and manage daily IPD, OPD, emergency, cash, credit, and corporate billing activities.
* Prepare and verify interim bills and final bills for admitted patients.
* Ensure accurate billing of room rent, doctor consultations, investigations, procedures, OT charges, pharmacy, consumables, implants, and other hospital services.
* Verify patient details, billing entries, approved tariffs, packages, discounts, and concessions.
* Ensure all billable services are captured correctly in the Hospital Information System (HIS).
* Monitor billing accuracy and minimize billing errors and revenue leakage.

**B. Insurance and TPA Billing**

* Coordinate with insurance companies and TPAs for cashless approvals and claim processing.
* Ensure timely submission of pre-authorization requests, enhancement requests, and final bills.
* Verify insurance approvals, policy limits, package rates, exclusions, and non-payable items.
* Follow up on pending approvals, claim queries, rejected claims, and outstanding insurance payments.
* Maintain complete documentation for insurance, reimbursement, and corporate billing.
* Coordinate with the insurance department to resolve billing discrepancies and claim-related issues.

**C. Patient Discharge Management**

* Ensure timely preparation and verification of final bills before discharge.
* Coordinate with nursing, pharmacy, laboratory, radiology, OT, and other departments to verify all charges.
* Ensure the collection of pending patient balances after insurance approval, wherever applicable.
* Explain billing details, deductions, non-payable items, and outstanding amounts to patients and their attendants.
* Monitor discharge turnaround time (TAT) and take corrective action to avoid unnecessary delays.

**D. Revenue Cycle and Collection Management**

* Monitor daily billing, collections, credit billing, and outstanding receivables.
* Follow up on pending payments from corporate clients, insurance companies, and TPAs.
* Reconcile daily billing transactions, receipts, refunds, and adjustments.
* Identify billing discrepancies and coordinate with the Finance Department for resolution.
* Prepare accounts receivable ageing reports and follow up on overdue accounts.
* Support revenue cycle improvement initiatives to improve collection efficiency.

**E. MIS and Reporting**

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly billing reports.
* Submit reports on total billing, collections, outstanding amounts, pending claims, and rejected claims.
* Monitor billing errors, discharge delays, and claim settlement status.
* Maintain accurate billing records and supporting documents.
* Submit regular performance reports to the Billing Manager.

**F. Team Coordination and Compliance**

* Coordinate with doctors, nursing staff, pharmacy, diagnostics, front office, insurance, and finance teams.
* Guide billing executives and ensure adherence to established billing procedures.
* Handle escalated patient billing complaints professionally.
* Ensure compliance with hospital policies, approved tariffs, and insurance requirements.
* Maintain confidentiality of patient information and financial records.
* Support internal and external billing audits.

3. Educational Qualifications and Experience

* Graduate in any discipline; B.Com, BBA, Hospital Administration, or Healthcare Management preferred.
* Minimum **3–5 years of experience in hospital billing operations**.
* Experience in a multispecialty or super-specialty hospital is preferred.
* Practical knowledge of IPD, OPD, cash, credit, corporate, insurance, and TPA billing.
* Experience in discharge billing, claim processing, and payment follow-up.
* Knowledge of hospital billing software and Hospital Information Systems (HIS/HMS).

4. Required Skills and Competencies

* Strong knowledge of hospital billing procedures.
* Good understanding of insurance and TPA processes.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and hospital billing software.
* Strong numerical, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to manage multiple billing activities under time pressure.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Good coordination and team management skills.
* Ability to handle patient complaints professionally.

The ideal candidate should be confident, approachable, and passionate about guiding students towards suitable educational opportunities. Candidates with experience in IAS/UPSC coaching, competitive examination coaching, or educational admissions will be given preference.

**Manager - Integration Solutioning & Technical Leadership (US Shift)**

Department: Integrations

Shift: US Shift (aligned to US business hours, 3:00 PM - 12:00 AM IST)

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a hands-on Manager to lead Integrations for a portfolio of US-based clients, working in the US shift. You will lead and grow a team of Technical Consultants responsible for integration solutioning and development — owning technical direction, guiding solution design, and ensuring high-quality delivery of new and enhanced integration interfaces. You will be the primary integrations point of contact for client leadership during US business hours, drive periodic leadership connects through demos and meetups, and step in hands-on to help the team solve complex issues on integration interfaces when needed. Our team already uses AI for solutioning and writing code — as a quick learner, you will deepen and scale this practice across the team.

**Key Responsibilities**

* 1. Lead and manage a team of 2-4 Technical Consultants — set priorities, plan capacity, run performance reviews, hire and develop talent, mentor on solutioning, and drive accountability for integration outcomes.

* 2. Own integration solutioning end to end — translate client requirements and change requests into robust designs (APIs, file-based flows, middleware patterns) and guide the team through build and delivery.

* 3. Lead and review the solutioning work done by Technical Consultants — ensure code quality, reusability, maintainability, and alignment with platform and integration standards.

* 4. Act as the technical lead for key integration engagements — drive architecture decisions, design reviews, and complex solutioning discussions with clients and internal stakeholders.

* 5. Drive client leadership connects with US clients through demos and meetups, in their time zone — showcase integration capabilities, walk through solution approaches, align on roadmap priorities, and strengthen executive-level confidence in delivery.

* 6. Own escalations and production issues on integration interfaces during US hours — debug failures, unblock consultants on complex interface problems, restore stable data flows, and communicate status to client stakeholders.

* 7. Stay hands-on with Python and integration tooling to review, guide, and when required, contribute to builds and troubleshooting on integration interfaces.

* 8. Build on the team's existing use of AI for solutioning and writing code — as a quick learner, strengthen AI-assisted design, coding, review, and documentation practices so the team delivers faster with consistent quality.

* 9. Partner with India-based Product/Engineering teams on platform capabilities, ensuring clean handoffs across time zones on integration patterns and enhancements needed for scalable client solutions.

* 10. Build and maintain solutioning standards, reusable patterns, and technical documentation so the team can deliver consistently as engagement volume grows.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 6-10 years of experience in technical consulting, integration solutioning/development, or similar roles within HRTech/SaaS or enterprise software.

* Proven experience managing Technical Consultants or similar delivery teams (3+ years in a people-management role) — including hiring, performance management, quality oversight, and owning delivery outcomes.

* Strong hands-on programming ability in Python — comfortable writing, reading, reviewing, and debugging integration code.

* Solid expertise in system integrations (REST/SOAP APIs, file-based integrations, middleware) with the ability to design and solution complex integration landscapes.

* Demonstrated ability to help teams diagnose and resolve issues on integration interfaces in production environments.

* Experience engaging client leadership through demos, technical meetups, and executive-facing solution discussions.

* Experience working with US/North American clients, and willingness to work the US shift on a sustained basis.

* A quick learner who already uses AI tools for solutioning and writing code (e.g., LLM-based assistants, coding copilots) and can strengthen this practice across a delivery team.

* Excellent client-facing communication and stakeholder management skills — able to explain technical designs clearly and lead solution discussions with both technical and leadership audiences.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset with the ability to balance leadership responsibilities and hands-on technical contribution.

**Good to Have**

* JavaScript experience — a plus for integration builds, scripting, and related client-side or middleware work.

* Prior direct experience with the Darwinbox platform or similar HRMS/HCM products.

* Exposure to standard and custom integration patterns (SFTP, REST/SOAP APIs, middleware tools).

* Experience scaling AI-assisted solutioning and coding practices across a consulting or engineering team.

**What Success Looks Like**

  

Within the first two quarters, this person will have become the trusted integrations lead for US client leadership, established clear ownership of integration solutioning and development quality across their team, built a strong rhythm of client leadership demos and meetups, helped stabilize and resolve complex integration interface issues, and strengthened the team's existing AI-driven approach to solutioning and coding — leaving behind a high-performing US-shift Technical Consultant team capable of scaling delivery with consistent quality.
